title: Speed dice recolour (Library of Ruina)
description: Port of the Switch plugin from Library-of-Ruina-CustomDice-NX-Mod: per-floor / per-story speed-dice sprites and colours, the infinity die. Needs the mod's PNGs in the romfs overlay.

launcher.label: Custom Speed Dice
launcher.note: Faction-based custom speed dices. Original mod by [PattyHoswell’s Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2746914901)

obs._comment: main build ID (first 16 bytes of the module ID, 32 hex digits) -> rows {gate, offset, word, reason}; word = the 4 bytes at offset read as a little-endian u32. Rows found with dump.cs/script.json RVAs and the DmIOS binary (main = RVA + 0x230000 in its file).

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: StageController.ApplyLibrarianCardPhase entry (a 11-instruction leaf with no later safe point, so before the original, not after): x0 = the StageController
after the only call of SpeedDiceUI.Init (bl 0x233bf20 at 0x233bba0): x23 = the SpeedDiceUI, w27 = faction
SpeedDiceUI.ChangeSprite, value >= 999 path (b.ge 0x233b8e0), before its epilogue and tail call: x19 = the SpeedDiceUI, w20 = value
